title: Meridiansz/MT5-Popular-Charts-Dashboard
text: MT5 market watch WinForms dashboard with multi-asset live charts, symbol cards, timeframe filters, and WebSocket bridge for forex, metals, crypto, and indices.

title: ZovraT/MT5-volume-profile-indicator
text: MQL5 volume profile indicator for MT5 — maps high-volume nodes, value areas, and price acceptance zones to identify institutional supply & demand levels. Built for SMC and ICT traders who confluence volume with market structure.

title: Zypheronz/MT5-Master-Slave-Trade-Copier
text: Ultra-low-latency master-slave trade MetaTrader copier for MT5 / MT4. Replicates orders across unlimited slave accounts and brokers with lot scaling, symbol mapping, reverse mode, partial-close sync and per-slave risk filters.

title: Zypheronz/TradingView-Webhook-MT5-Bridge
text: TradingView-to-MT5 webhook bridge. Receives MetaTrader JSON alerts from Pine Script strategies, validates each payload with a passphrase and forwards BUY / SELL orders to MT5 / MT4 via named pipe in milliseconds for automated alert execution.

title: Quorvathz/MT5-Gateway-Trend-Classifier
text: Institutional MT5 gateway dashboard with secure login, multi-asset trend classification, long/short regime cards, and WebSocket market stream parsing on Windows.

title: Valtorim/MT5-PropFirm-Drawdown-Guard
text: Equity guard and drawdown protector MetaTrader for MT5 / MT4 prop firm traders. Enforces daily loss limits, trailing or static max drawdown, hard kill-switch and FTMO / MyForexFunds / FundedNext rule presets to keep funded accounts alive.

title: Solasent/MT5-SMC-Institutional-Liquidity-Scanner
text: Smart Money Concepts (SMC) MetaTrader scanner for MT5 / MT4. Auto-detects order blocks, fair value gaps, liquidity sweeps, equal highs / lows and BOS / CHoCH structure shifts across multiple symbols and timeframes for ICT-style traders.

title: Avenmoqe/MT5-Telegram-Signal-AutoTrader
text: Telegram-to-MT5 signal auto-trader for forex channel MetaTrader followers. Parses BUY / SELL / LONG / SHORT messages with regex templates, extracts entry, SL and TP levels, sizes the lot and pushes orders to MT5 / MT4 via named pipe.

title: Vandoriz/MT5-OrderFlow-Footprint-Engine
text: Real-time order-flow MetaTrader footprint chart engine for MT5 / MT4. Renders bid x ask volume clusters, delta heatmaps, imbalance stacks and absorption zones from streaming tick data, built for tape-reading and microstructure traders.

title: Valtorim/MT5-Portfolio-Correlation-Matrix
text: Real-time multi-symbol correlation matrix, MetaTrader currency strength meter and basket exposure heatmap for MT5 / MT4. Exposes hidden cross-pair risk, hedged positions and redundant trades across an entire forex portfolio.

title: Quorvathz/Prop-Matrix-Engine

title: Solasent/MT5-Live-Strategy-Backtest-Engine
text: Bar-by-bar replay engine and MetaTrader live forward-test platform for MT5 / MT4. Replays history at adjustable speed, runs strategies on streaming feeds, and reports equity curve, drawdown, profit factor and Sharpe ratio side by side.

title: ZrakD/MT5-Risk-Management-EA
text: MQL5 risk management EA for MT5 — automates breakeven, trailing stop, partial close, and equity protection across all open positions. Designed to run alongside any strategy or EA without interfering with entry logic.
